1. Acceptance of Terms
By creating an account and using this application, you agree to comply with these Terms & Conditions. If you do not accept these terms, do not use the app.

2. Purpose of the App
This application is a personal productivity and self-improvement tool designed to help users organize daily tasks through gamified mechanics (quests, XP, levels, and streaks). It is intended for personal organization and motivation only and does not constitute professional medical, psychological, or career advice.

3. User-Created Content (Custom Quests)
You are solely responsible for the custom quests, tasks, and notes you create and edit within the app. You agree not to input harmful, illegal, or offensive content.

4. Virtual Currency, EXP & Rewards
Experience points (EXP or XP), levels, streaks, achievements, and coins earned through completing quests are virtual items used solely within the app’s Reward Shop. Virtual coins hold no real-world monetary value, cannot be exchanged for real currency, and are non-transferable.

5. Account Responsibility
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials (username, email, and password) and for all activity that occurs under your account.

6. App Availability & Updates
As an evolving software project, features, predefined quest datasets, and Reward Shop items may be updated, modified, or reset to improve performance and user experience. We are not liable for any temporary interruptions or loss of local/account progress.

7. Termination
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or attempt to manipulate the app’s system. You may stop using the app or delete your account at any time.

1. Information We Collect
To provide a personalized productivity experience, we collect the following information when you register and use the app:
• Account Information: Your full name, username, email address, and encrypted password.
• Productivity & Game Data: Custom quests you create or edit, completed daily quests, XP, level progress, coin balance, daily streaks, unlocked achievements, and Reward Shop redemption.
• App Preferences: Your notification and display settings.

2. How We Use Your Information
We use the collected data strictly to operate and improve the application, specifically to:
• Create and maintain your user profile and login session.
• Track your daily quest completion, calculate XP/level-ups, and update your self-improvement stats.
• Manage your virtual coin balance and Reward Shop transactions.
• Send optional reminders and notifications for daily quests, level-ups, and achievements.

3. Data Storage & Security
Your account details and progress data are stored securely to prevent unauthorized access or accidental loss. Passwords are protected, and we do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information or quest logs to third parties.

4. Your Rights & Control
You remain in full control of your personal data inside the app:
• View & Edit: You can update your name, username, email, password, and custom quests at any time via the Manage Account and quest menus.
• Delete Data: You may clear your progress or delete your account, which permanently removes your profile and productivity history from the system.

5. Policy Updates
We may update this Privacy Policy as new features are added to the application. Any changes will be reflected by the "Last Updated" date at the top of this screen.
